help.lang: screen language (default: LGPRUNE_LANG, then LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG)
help.description: Retention for LangGraph checkpoint databases (SQLite, Postgres): see what takes space, plan what to delete without breaking resume, interrupts or DeltaChannel threads, apply it in one transaction, and give the space back.
help.epilog:
typical flow:
  lgprune report agent.sqlite
  lgprune plan agent.sqlite --trim-after 1d --delete-after 30d -o plan.json
  lgprune apply plan.json --yes --backup agent.bak.sqlite
  lgprune reclaim agent.sqlite --yes

exit codes: 0 ok, 1 usage/connection error, 2 safety refusal, 3 verify mismatch (rolled back)
first time? run: lgprune tour
help.report: show size per thread: rows, bytes, latest vs history, top channel, idle days, flags
help.report.desc: Show where the space goes, per thread. Read-only.
help.plan: decide what to trim or delete with a policy (read-only)
help.plan.desc: Make a plan from a retention policy. Read-only: the database is not changed.
help.apply: apply a plan in one transaction (preview unless --yes)
help.apply.desc: Apply a plan. Without --yes it only prints the plan. With --yes every target is re-checked inside one transaction, and the head state is compared with the plan before commit.
help.verify: check that the head state still matches the plan
help.verify.desc: Compare the current head state with the fingerprints saved in the plan.
help.reclaim: give freed space back (SQLite VACUUM + WAL truncate; Postgres guidance)
help.reclaim.desc: Shrink the database file after deleting rows. Needs --yes.
help.sample.desc: Write an example database made by real LangGraph graphs (synthetic messages, no LLM).
help.tour: run the whole flow on a temporary sample database
help.tour.desc: Create a sample, show why naive DELETE loses DeltaChannel state, then report, plan, apply, verify and reclaim.
help.db: SQLite file or postgresql:// URL (default: LGPRUNE_DB)
help.json: print JSON (keys and reason codes do not depend on --lang)
help.top: show only the N largest threads
help.now: pretend the current time is ISO (for tests and dry runs)
help.trim_after: keep only the latest checkpoint of threads idle this long (e.g. 12h, 1d)
help.keep_recent: never touch the N most recently active threads (default 10)
help.include: only consider thread IDs matching this glob (repeatable)
help.exclude: never touch thread IDs matching this glob (repeatable)
help.threads: only these thread IDs, comma separated (safety checks still apply)
help.include_interrupted: also touch threads waiting at an interrupt (off by default)
help.output: save the plan JSON to FILE
help.backup: SQLite: write a backup copy here before deleting
help.busy_timeout: how long to wait for a lock (default 5s)
help.db_override: use this database instead of the one recorded in the plan
help.analyze: Postgres: run VACUUM (ANALYZE) on the checkpoint tables (with --yes)
help.keep: keep the tour files in DIR instead of a temporary folder
err.plan_format: not a valid lgprune plan file ({detail})
err.plan_db: the plan was made for {plan_db}, not {db} (use --db to override)
err.schema: {path} has no LangGraph '{table}' table with the expected columns
err.locked: the database is busy (another writer holds the lock): {detail}. Nothing was changed; try again or raise --busy-timeout.
err.disk_space: not enough free disk space for VACUUM ({free} bytes free, about {need} needed)
err.pg_extra: Postgres support needs the extra: pip install 'lgprune[postgres]'
err.pg_connect_nopw: cannot connect to Postgres: {detail}. The URL has no password (plan files never store it): set PGPASSWORD, use ~/.pgpass or pass --db URL.
err.pg_schema: no LangGraph checkpoint tables in this database (missing: {missing})
err.pg_no_prune: the installed langgraph-checkpoint-postgres has no prune(). Upgrade it: pip install -U 'langgraph-checkpoint-postgres>=3.2.0'
err.retries: gave up after repeated concurrent-update conflicts: {detail}. Nothing was changed.
err.delta_refused: the official prune refused a DeltaChannel thread ({threads}). Nothing was changed.
err.pg_backup: --backup is for SQLite; for Postgres use pg_dump before applying
err.unsafe: refused keep_latest for {threads}: the thread uses a DeltaChannel or a format lgprune cannot check, and trimming would silently lose its state. Nothing was changed (rolled back).
err.mismatch: head state changed while pruning {names}. Rolled back - nothing was changed.
err.no_db: no database given (pass a path / postgresql:// URL or set LGPRUNE_DB)
